page: Microsoft Azure E8ds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance provides 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It features 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The hardware configuration includes 307 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage, managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations place the E8ds_v5 in the average performance tier across most compute and memory workloads. It achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1638.0 and a multi-core score of 6145.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 11541.37. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only large-block bandwidth of 62.3 GB/sec and a write large-block bandwidth of 44.14 GB/sec. For database operations, the instance handles 7.88 million Redis SET operations per second and scores 4113.21 on Passmark database tests.

While the instance is highly capable for memory-intensive applications, it exhibits performance limitations on complex AI workloads. LLM inference benchmarks show a weak performance tier for medium 7B models, yielding only 17.36 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 6.39 tokens/sec for text generation. However, its high memory density and local storage make it a cost-efficient choice for relational databases, caching layers, data analytics, and memory-bound enterprise applications that do not require GPU acceleration.
